channel.title: Post-Trap Futurism: The Catalog Sessions
channel.description: That Boy Hi Hat created Post-Trap Futurism — alternative rap built independently in Frederick, Maryland under Cumulative Web Inc. The Catalog Sessions tells the story of his 24-song catalog, one track per episode: where each song came from, how it was made, and why it sounds like the future. Hosted by Marcus and Nia. Every episode ends with the full song, start to finish. Breakout single 'Zooted Zone' passed 300,000 lifetime Spotify plays; the single 'Diabolique' — produced by Hybrid, co-produced by Black Lansky — anchors his 2025 album Post Trap Futurism: The Logo Effect. Human-made, independently released, broadcast quality. The genre, defined by its creator.

item.title: Episode 1: Origin Story — Post-Trap Futurism | That Boy Hi Hat
item.description: That Boy Hi Hat created Post-Trap Futurism — alternative rap built independently in Maryland under Cumulative Web Inc. This is episode one of The Catalog Sessions: the origin story, told before track one. Over 25 episodes, hosts Marcus and Nia walk through his entire 24-song catalog — not just the hits, every song: where each one came from, how it was made, and why it sounds like the future. Trap gave rap its drums for a decade. Post-Trap Futurism is what comes after: the weight and the bounce, reaching for something bigger — cinematic textures, left-field melodies, rap beaming in from five years ahead. Independent label, human-made, broadcast quality. Every episode ends with the full song, start to finish. No clips, no teases. The whole thing.
